summary: 28/30 requirements PASS. The generated documentation is high-quality: all four phases executed correctly, format is faithful to templates, dependency sections are specific and function-level, module naming is functional, and the two-document model with markers enables AI navigation. The single systemic gap is source file coverage: state.json reports 17.87% vs the required 80% threshold. This occurs because the agent correctly uses grouped documentation for large homogeneous tutorial directories (162 files under 3 blocks in advanced_middleware; 197 files under 7 blocks in main) — a pragmatic choice that produces useful docs — but the QUALITY_STANDARDS.md coverage definition requires individual <!-- file:xxx --> blocks per file. The Skill documentation creates an unresolvable tension: the token budget protocol encourages grouping similar files, but the coverage gate demands per-file blocks. Fix priority: update QUALITY_STANDARDS.md to define 'tutorial grouping' as a valid coverage method, and update phase4-index.md to provide concrete guidance for achieving 80% coverage in tutorial-heavy repos.
